additional_info.subject: RE: 0370943 - ID0370943-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170001958] The charging station on the LP1 keeps having a fault CRM:00641000613
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard Semiraut,
Hope you are doing well.
We have reviewed the logs on AWS CloudWatch and found some anomalies regarding the contactor Q21-22 and QA13-14, which are used for charging via the DC1 & DC2 outlets. During the cable check, we observed that the contactor's feedback goes into an abnormal state. According to the standard for cable checks, both side contactors (charger and EV) should close properly for the cable check to be performed successfully.
Kindly refer to the logs below where we can see that the contactors are showing abnormal states:
We recommend planning for a site intervention to check the QA21-22 and QA13-14 contactors. We suspect there might be an issue with the feedback contactor and the wires used for status purposes.
Please refer to the marked images below for reference to trace out the issue. Additionally, please carry spare contactors in case a replacement is needed.
Note -: Please refer the same for the Contactors QA13-14 as well.
For today's session, we found that the charging session failed during the authentication process. This issue requires further investigation during the site intervention.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0370943
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
